messages:
jamie: Heads-up — ran into noisy ANSI escape codes in kube logs during a deploy that break our deploy-bot's parsing. Thinking of adding a --strip-ansi flag to the bot and a small 'deployctl' helper for quick pin+rollback toggles.
sarah: ugh those escape sequences are the worst. can you paste an example?
jamie: here's a short snippet from the pod logs:
```
\u001b[0mINFO: starting rollout
\u001b[32mOK\u001b[0m scaled up search-worker x3
```
deploy-bot: noticed parse error at "\u001b" token when extracting rollout events, forwarded to infra team.
vikas: can we prefilter at log-ingress (fluent) or do it at the bot? prefer bot-level normalization so logs in storage stay verbatim but our control plane accepts them.
maya: proposal: add `--strip-ansi` to `/deploy` and also add a `--pin-toggle` helper that does pin/unpin and posts a release-note template. also shorthand `--cw` for change-window.
jamie: sketch of the user command: `/deploy service=search env=prod version=2026-03-21-9 --canary 5% --pin-on-success --strip-ansi --cw "02:00-03:00 UTC"`
sarah: nice. what about rollback ergonomics? we still spend time composing the rollback call.
maya: add `deployctl pin <service> <version>` and `deployctl rollback <service> <target_version>` small wrapper that calls the bot API and posts standardized comments. sample `deployctl` quick script: 
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deployctl quick pin+rollback helper (prototype)
BOT_CLI=/usr/local/bin/deploy-bot-cli
cmd="$1"; svc="$2"; ver="$3"
if [ "$cmd" = "pin" ]; then
  $BOT_CLI request --service "$svc" --version "$ver" --action pin --confirm
elif [ "$cmd" = "rollback" ]; then
  $BOT_CLI request --service "$svc" --target-version "$ver" --action rollback --force
else
  echo "usage: deployctl (pin|rollback) <service> <version>"
fi
```
vikas: also add `--dry-run` default for unknown services, and require ephemeral confirmation for live runs (emoji :thumbsup: within 5m). reduces accidental pins.
sarah: for release notes, let's standardize a pinned comment template the bot can post when `--pin-on-success` used: 
```
Release: search
Version: 2026-03-21-9
Change window: 02:00-03:00 UTC
Risk: low
Notes:
- perf: KV cache batching fix
- rollback plan: revert to 2026-03-20-3 via deployctl rollback
```
maya: and the bot should add a small machine-readable label in the comment header so downstream tooling can pick it up (eg `//META: change_window=02:00-03:00;pin=true`).
jamie: ops constraints: ops-bot flags anything outside 00:00-06:00 UTC for manual approval. ops-bot?
ops-bot: approval required from #ops-team for change windows outside 00:00-06:00 UTC; requesting ack.
vikas: I'll add unit tests: parser should strip any `\u001b\[` sequences before tokenizing events; add fixture logs.
maya: i'll draft the PR (infra/deploy-enhancements) with three commits: bot flag, CLI shim, release-template. tagging eng-releases and eng-platform. timeline: patch by EOD, tests + demo in next release sync.
jamie: I'll open the PR and assign reviewers. who wants to take initial review?
sarah: I'll take initial review and smoke test the flow on staging. ping ops for change-window approval once we have the PR.
maya: small UX note: add `--cw` validation (reject malformed ranges), and make `--pin-on-success` idempotent (no-op if already pinned).
jamie: agreed. also add analytics event `deploy.pin_toggle` for cost tracking.
vikas: one more: prefer a short human-friendly confirmation message from the bot rather than raw JSON. e.g. "Pin created: search @ 2026-03-21-9 — change window 02:00-03:00 UTC — ack with :thumbsup: to proceed".
jamie: perfect. moving to action. :rocket:
deploy-bot: automated: opened PR infra/deploy-enhancements#412 with draft changes (bot: add --strip-ansi, --pin-toggle; cli: deployctl shim; tests), pinged @eng-releases @eng-platform.
maya: I'll add the release-note template as a small generator snippet in the PR too.
jamie: thanks all. will update thread with PR link and short demo gif when ready. :eyes:
